_comment: Equipment slot definitions for the inventory page. Add or reorder slots here, no code change required. id is the stable storage key; label is the user-visible string. Since character animation rung 2b (2026-11-10) the two grip sockets (grip_r, grip_l) hold what is held (tools and weapons; humanoid.ron's grip_r and grip_l sockets); hands is what is worn on them (gloves).
